name: @activepieces/piece-sendr
description: Create personalized landing pages, dynamic audio, video, and manage campaigns with Sendr.

auth.description:
**How to get your API key:**
1. Log in to your Sendr dashboard at https://app.sendr.io.
2. Go to **Settings > API Keys**.
3. Click **Create New Key**.
4. Copy the key and paste it below.

Need help? Contact Sendr support at https://sendr.io/support

get_user_info.name: get_user_info
get_user_info.description: Returns information about the currently connected Sendr API user. Useful for verifying that your API key is valid.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the Sendr account/seat tied to the connected API key. Use it to verify the connection is valid or to read the current user identity before other Sendr calls. Read-only; takes no input.

list_sheets.name: list_sheets
list_sheets.description: Lists all available contact lists (sheets) in your Sendr workspace.

aiMetadata.description: Lists all contact lists (sheets) in the Sendr workspace, returning each sheet id and name. Use it to discover the sheet id needed by sheet-scoped actions like Get Sheet, Get Sheet Columns, or Add Row to Sheet. Read-only; takes no input.

get_sheet.name: get_sheet
get_sheet.description: Returns details of a specific contact list (sheet).

sheet.description: Select the contact list (sheet) to use.

instructions.description:
### How to Add a Row
1. Select the target sheet above.
2. Enter the row data below using column names as keys and the cell values as values.

rowData.description: Key-value pairs representing the new row. Keys should match the sheet column names. Example: { "Email": "john@example.com", "First Name": "John" }

aiMetadata.description: Appends a new contact/record row to a sheet. Provide the sheet id and a key-value object where keys match the sheet column names (call Get Sheet Columns first to learn them). Not idempotent: each call inserts another row.

list_campaigns.name: list_campaigns
list_campaigns.description: Lists all campaigns in your Sendr workspace, optionally filtered by status.

status.description: Filter campaigns by their current status.

aiMetadata.description: Lists campaigns in the Sendr workspace (up to 50), optionally narrowed by status (Draft, Active, or Paused); leaving the status filter empty returns all campaigns. Use it to discover the campaign id needed by Get Campaign. Read-only.

get_campaign.name: get_campaign
get_campaign.description: Returns detailed information about a specific campaign.

aiMetadata.description: Lists the Sendr Page templates available for building personalized landing pages, returning each template id and name. Use it to discover the template id needed by Generate Sendr Page or Get Page Template Variables. Read-only; takes no input.

get_page_template_variables.name: get_page_template_variables
get_page_template_variables.description: Returns the custom variables (placeholders) defined in a selected page template � for example first_name, company, or email.

generate_sendr_page.name: generate_sendr_page
generate_sendr_page.description: Creates a personalized Sendr landing page from a template with custom variables.

instructions.description:
### How to Generate a Page
1. Choose a **Page Template** below.
2. Fill in the variable values (e.g. first_name = "Anna", company = "Acme").
3. Optionally provide a website URL to screenshot, or enable GIF/audio rendering.

template.description: Select a Sendr Page template to generate content from.

auth.description:
**How to get your API key:**
1. Log in to your Sendr dashboard at https://app.sendr.io.
2. Go to **Settings > API Keys**.
3. Click **Create New Key**.
4. Copy the key and paste it below.

Need help? Contact Sendr support at https://sendr.io/support

websiteUrl.description: Optional. Provide a website URL if the template supports background screenshots.

renderGif.description: If enabled, Sendr will generate an animated GIF version of the page.

attributes.description: Optional metadata attributes for the generated page (key-value pairs).

webhookUrl.description: Optional callback URL to receive status updates (e.g. when GIF or audio is ready).

variables.description: Key-value pairs matching the template variables. Example: { "first_name": "Anna", "company": "Acme Inc" }

aiMetadata.description: Creates a personalized Sendr landing page by rendering a template with supplied variable values; optionally screenshots a website background, renders an animated GIF, and posts status updates to a callback URL. Requires a template id and a key-value variables object (use Get Page Template Variables to find the keys). Not idempotent: each call generates a new page.

queue_dynamic_audio.name: queue_dynamic_audio
queue_dynamic_audio.description: Queues a job to generate personalized audio by replacing a target word in a base audio file.

audioUrl.description: Public URL of the base audio file to personalize.

targetWord.description: The word to find and replace in the audio (e.g. "first_name" or "[NAME]").

replacementWord.description: The word to insert in place of the target word (e.g. "Anna").

elevenlabsId.description: Optional ElevenLabs voice ID for the generated audio.

webhookUrl.description: Optional callback URL to receive status updates when the audio job is done.

aiMetadata.description: Queues an async job that produces personalized audio by replacing a target word in a base audio file with a replacement word, optionally using a specific ElevenLabs voice and language. Requires the base audio URL, target word, and replacement word; results are delivered later (optionally to a callback URL). Not idempotent: each call enqueues a new generation job.

queue_video_generation.name: queue_video_generation
queue_video_generation.description: Queues a job to merge audio and video or generate a lipsync video.

audioUrl.description: Public URL of the audio track to use.

videoUrl.description: Public URL of the base video to use.

muxAssetId.description: Optional Mux asset ID for the video source.

pageSlug.description: Optional Sendr Page slug to associate with this video.

webhookUrl.description: Optional callback URL to receive status updates when the video job is done.

aiMetadata.description: Queues an async video-generation job in one of two modes: merge an audio track onto a base video, or produce a lipsync video. Requires the mode and audio URL (plus a video/Mux source as the mode needs); results are delivered later (optionally to a callback URL). Not idempotent: each call enqueues a new job.

list_webhooks.name: list_webhooks
list_webhooks.description: Lists all registered webhooks in your Sendr workspace.

aiMetadata.description: Lists all webhooks registered in the Sendr workspace, returning each webhook URL, name, subscribed events, and enabled state. Use it to discover the webhook URL (the identifier) needed by Update/Delete/Toggle Webhook or Reveal Webhook Secret. Read-only; takes no input.

create_webhook.name: create_webhook
create_webhook.description: Registers a new webhook in Sendr to receive event notifications.

name.description: A human-readable name for the webhook.

url.description: The endpoint URL that Sendr will call when events occur.

events.description: List of event names to subscribe to (e.g. page_render:created, contact_page_engagement:created).

attributes.description: Optional metadata attributes for the webhook.

resourceType.description: Optional resource type filter for the webhook.

resourceId.description: Optional resource ID filter for the webhook.

aiMetadata.description: Registers a new webhook so Sendr posts event notifications to a target URL. Requires a name, the destination URL, and a list of event names to subscribe to (e.g. page_render:created, contact_page_engagement:created). Not idempotent: each call registers another webhook.

update_webhook.name: update_webhook
update_webhook.description: Updates an existing Sendr webhook by its URL.

page_render_created.name: page_render_created
page_render_created.description: Triggers when a new Sendr Page is rendered.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new personalized Sendr Page is rendered, delivering the page id, URL, slug, and source template. Use it to act each time a page is freshly generated.

page_render_updated.name: page_render_updated
page_render_updated.description: Triggers when a Sendr Page render is updated (e.g. GIF or audio is ready).

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an existing Sendr Page render is updated, typically when asynchronously produced assets become ready (GIF, audio, or lipsync video). Use it to react once media for a page has finished generating.

contact_page_engagement_created.name: contact_page_engagement_created
contact_page_engagement_created.description: Triggers when a contact visits a Sendr Page for the first time.

aiMetadata.description: Fires the first time a contact engages with (visits) a Sendr Page, delivering the page id/slug/URL and the contact attributes. Use it to act on a contact first visiting a page.

contact_page_engagement_updated.name: contact_page_engagement_updated
contact_page_engagement_updated.description: Triggers when a contact interacts with a Sendr Page again (e.g. replays, re-visits).

aiMetadata.description: Fires on subsequent engagement when a contact interacts with a Sendr Page again (re-visit or replay), delivering the page id/slug/URL, contact attributes, and engagement status. Use it to track repeat interaction after the initial visit.

de.Create personalized landing pages, dynam: Erstellen Sie personalisierte Landingpages, dynamisches Audio, Video und verwalten Sie Kampagnen mit Sendr.
de.\n**How to get your API key:**\n1. Log i:
**Wie man seinen API-Schlüssel bekommt:**
1. Melde dich bei deinem Sendr-Dashboard unter https://app an. Endr.io.
2. Gehen Sie zu **Einstellungen > API Keys**.
3. Klicken Sie auf **Neuen Schlüssel erstellen**.
4. Kopieren Sie den Schlüssel und fügen Sie ihn unten ein.

Brauchst du Hilfe? Kontaktiere den Sendr-Support unter https://sendr.io/support

de.Returns details of a specific contact li: Gibt Details einer bestimmten Kontaktliste (Blatt) zurück.
de.Returns all columns (fields) of a contac: Gibt alle Spalten (Felder) einer Kontaktliste einschließlich ihres Anreicherungsstatus zurück.

de.Returns detailed information about a spe: Gibt detaillierte Informationen über eine bestimmte Kampagne zurück.
de.Lists all available Sendr Page templates: Listet alle verfügbaren Sendr-Seitenvorlagen auf, die Sie verwenden können, um personalisierte Landingpages zu erstellen.
de.Returns the custom variables (placeholde: Gibt die benutzerdefinierten Variablen (Platzhalter) zurück, die in einer ausgewählten Seitenvorlage definiert sind – zum Beispiel Vorname, Firma oder E-Mail.
de.Creates a personalized Sendr landing pag: Erstellt eine personalisierte Sendr-Zielseite aus einer Vorlage mit benutzerdefinierten Variablen.
de.Queues a job to generate personalized au: Queues a job to create personalized audio by replacing a target word in a base audio file.
de.Queues a job to merge audio and video or: Warteschlange einen Job um Audio und Video zusammenzuführen oder ein Livesync-Video zu generieren.

de.Deletes a registered Sendr webhook by it: Löscht einen registrierten Sendr Webhook über die URL.
